verses.text: Ayik ix lajwi yak'an owal winhaj Saúl yet' heb' filisteo chi', ix alji t'a winh to ha t'a tzinan lu'um t'a En-gadi ayek' winhaj David chi'.

Yuj chi' oxe' mil heb' soldado te jelan t'a skal heb' israel ix sik'el winhaj Saúl chi', yik sb'at heb' sayek' winhaj David chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh t'a sattak k'e'en k'e'en b'aj ay nok' k'ultakil chiwa.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado t'a juntzanh te' makte' kalnel t'a ti' b'e, ix och winh chuljel t'a yol jun k'e'en nhak'e'en ay t'a slak'anil chi'. Manh yojtakoklaj winh tato hata' ayek' winhaj David yet' heb' soldado t'a yichochk'och k'e'en chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh ajun yet' winhaj David chi': --Ha tikne'ik ix elk'och tas ix yal Jehová to syak'och winh ajk'o'ol t'a yol a k'ab'. Ha ach tza na'a tas tzutej, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Ix k'e wa'an winh, te k'ojank'olal ix kot winh, ix spolanel jab' sti' sjukan pichul winhaj Saúl chi' winh.
Ixlajwi yutan winh icha chi', ix kuspaxk'e sk'o'ol winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ajun yet'ok chi' icha tik: --Aokab' Jehová max cha'an in milcham winh in reyal tik, yujto ha' sik'annakoch winh reyal, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj David chi' skachan heb' winh ajun yet'ok chi'. Maj yal-laj winh to ay tz'utaj winhaj Saúl chi' yuj heb' winh, tonhej ix yiloch heb' winh ix elixta winh t'a yol k'e'en nhak'e'en chi', ix b'atxikan winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj David chi' t'a spatik winh, ix awajb'at winh: --Mamin rey, xchib'at winh. Haxo ix meltzajb'at k'elan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spatik, ix em nhojnaj winhaj David chi', ix yalan winh:
--Mamin, ¿tas yuj tza cha ab' t'a heb' anima tz'alani to chuk tas tzin say t'a a patik?

Na'eli to a tikne'ik a Jehová ix ach ak'anoch t'a yol in k'ab' t'a yol k'e'en nhak'e'en tik. Ha heb' winh ajun wet'ok, ix yal heb' winh to tzach in milchamok, palta maj yal-laj in k'o'ol. Ix in na' to rey ach, a Jehová sik'annak ach och reyal.

Mamin, iltonab' jab' sti' a jukan pichul wet'nak tik. Te sekojtak ix aj ach in milanchamok tato ix yal in k'o'ol. Yuj chi' ha t'a jun tik syal snachajel u'uj to malaj tas chuk tzin na' t'a a patik, malaj b'aj ix wik'cha'anh in b'a t'ayach. Palta ¿tas yuj tzin a sayek'i yik tzin a milancham halani?
Ha tikne'ik, onh b'eyk'olajokab' ko chawanhil yuj Jehová Dios, mach tojol spensar, aokab' tz'ak'an spak t'ayach yuj tas tzin utej. Ha inxo tik jun, manh ol wak'och in k'ab' ach in milanchamok.
Ay jun lolonel syal heb' anima t'a peka' icha tik: Ha t'a heb' chuk, hata' skot chukal, xchi. Yuj chi' mamin rey, malaj b'ak'inh ol wak'och in k'ab' t'ayach.
Mamin rey, natonab'i to a ach tik sreyal ach Israel. Ha inxo wan in a sayanek' tik, tokwal ay jab'ok welk'ochi. Lajan in wal icha nok' chamnak tz'i', ma icha wal nok' k'ak.
Yuj chi' aokab' Jehová tzonh b'eyk'olan ko chawanhil, mach onh ay ko mul. Aokab' tz'ilan tas tzin utej tik, tzin skolanel t'ayach, xchi winh.
Haxo ix lajwi slolon winhaj David chi', ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi': --Ach David, ¿tom a ach tzach lolon chi' ma? xchi winh. Ix ok'k'e winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Ha ach tik te tojol a pensar. Te wach' ix utej a paktzitan in chuk pensaril t'ayach.
Ha wal tikne'ik tza ch'oxeli to wach' tzutej a pensar t'ayin. Ix in yak'waloch Jehová t'a yol a k'ab', palta maj in a milchamlaj.
Wal yel, malaj junok mach tato tz'ilchaj junok yajk'ol yuj, malaj tas syutej. Ha Jehová ol paktzitan t'ayach yuj jun a wach'k'olal tik t'ayin.
Ix nachajel wuj tikne'ik to a ach wal ol ach och reyal, yuj chi' a opisio t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik, malaj mach ol yal yik'anek' t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ak'kan a ti' t'ayin tikne'ik t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol a satel-laj winhtilal yet' heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, palta to ol in b'inajnhejkanok, xchi winh.

Ix yak'an sti' winhaj David chi' yuj tas ix yal winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spalacio, haxo pax winhaj David chi' yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok, ix ochixkan heb' winh t'a yoltak k'e'en nhak'e'en chi'.
